name: Sonoma Coast

contains: Green Valley of Russian River Valley

terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: Sonoma Coast is cool and rainy compared with the rest of the county, with so many microclimates that smaller coastal AVAs such as Fort Ross-Seaview and West Sonoma Coast were carved from it.
